cases.name: testWithCommonTableExpressions
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    WITH
      +any_cte AS (
        SELECT any_dtab~any_id, any_name, other_id, value_from, value_to
          FROM any_dtab
           INNER JOIN other_dtab ON other_dtab~any_id = any_dtab~any_id
          WHERE any_dtab~any_id BETWEEN @from_id AND @to_id ),

      +other_cte AS (
        SELECT any_id, other_id, SUM( any_value ) AS sum_value
          FROM third_dtab
          WHERE any_id BETWEEN @from_id AND @to_id
          GROUP BY any_id, other_id ),

      +result_cte( name, name2, name3, name4, name5 ) AS (
        SELECT any_name, c~other_id, value_from, value_to, sum_value
          FROM +any_cte AS c
            INNER JOIN +other_cte AS s ON  c~any_id = s~any_id
                                       AND c~other_id = s~other_id )

      SELECT * FROM +result_cte
        ORDER BY name, name2
        INTO TABLE @FINAL(result1).
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    WITH
      +any_cte AS (
        SELECT any_dtab~any_id,
               any_name,
               other_id,
               value_from,
               value_to
          FROM any_dtab
           INNER JOIN other_dtab ON other_dtab~any_id = any_dtab~any_id
          WHERE any_dtab~any_id BETWEEN @from_id AND @to_id ),

      +other_cte AS (
        SELECT any_id,
               other_id,
               SUM( any_value ) AS sum_value
          FROM third_dtab
          WHERE any_id BETWEEN @from_id AND @to_id
          GROUP BY any_id, other_id ),

      +result_cte( name, name2, name3, name4, name5 ) AS (
        SELECT any_name,
               c~other_id,
               value_from,
               value_to,
               sum_value
          FROM +any_cte AS c
            INNER JOIN +other_cte AS s ON  c~any_id = s~any_id
                                       AND c~other_id = s~other_id )

      SELECT * FROM +result_cte
        ORDER BY name, name2
        INTO TABLE @FINAL(result1).
  ENDMETHOD.
